sentences.text:
By way of the present petition filed under section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure 1973 ('Cr.P.C'), the petitioner seeks anticipatory bail in case FIR No.131/2021 dated 31.08.2021 under sections 409/420/120B of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 ('IPC') registered at P.S.:
Economic Offences Wing.
2. Learned counsel appearing for the petitioner submits, that the petitioner was a director of M/s Vasundra Fintech Ltd., but his directorship had ceased as of 26.08.2019.
The petitioner has placed on record copies of documents relating to the Registrar of Companies in support of this submission.

3. Counsel submit however, that the petitioner has now received a notice dated 04.07.2024 under section 41-A Cr.P.C. from the Investigating Officer, calling upon him to join investigation in the matter.
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 16/07/2024 at 02:38:13 4.

It is pointed-out that the petitioner's name does not appear in the FIR;
and the incident that is the subject matter of the FIR, as reported by the complainant, relates to a period after cessation of the petitioner's directorship of the company.

sentences.text: 5. Counsel submits that the petitioner has nothing to do with the incident in question; but that he is ready and willing to join the investigation.
Counsel however submits, that the petitioner apprehends arrest.
It is also submitted that the petitioner suffers from a heart condition, which is also one of the reasons why he has moved the present petition.
6. Issue notice.
7. Mr. Manoj Pant, learned APP appears on behalf of the State on advance copy; accepts notice; and seeks time to file status report.

8. Learned APP submits, that though the FIR has been registered at the instance of one complainant, the accused company has cheated a lot of small investors by taking small deposits from them, which money has subsequently not been returned.
Learned APP further submits, that the period of offence spans from the year 2011 to 2021, as stated in the FIR.

9. Learned APP also points-out, that the petitioner has not responded to the section 41-A Cr.P.C.
notice issued to him.

10. Let status report be filed at least 03 days before the next date.
11.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, it is directed that subject to the petitioner joining investigation as and when called by the Investigating Officer, he shall not be arrested till the next date of hearing.
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 16/07/2024 at 02:38:13 12.

As prayed for by the investigating officer, the petitioner is directed to report to P.S.: Economic Offences Wing, New Delhi at 11:00 a.m. tomorrow i.e. 13.07.2024.
13.
Re -notify on 04th October 2024.
ANUP JAIRAM BHAMBHANI, J JULY 12, 2024/V.Rawat
